decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development would, by reason of its siting, size and design, constitute an overdevelopment of the site and fail to meet Council housing standards representing inappropriate backland development. The proposal would be a cramped form of development, out of character with the locality and detrimental to the amenities of the local area.  The proposal is contrary to policies ENV.1.1 (All New Development), H.1.2 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.3.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development) of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan and associated Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development would, by reason of its size, position and appearance, fail to meet Council housing standards. The proposal would be unduly dominant and have an overbearing impact on neighbouring residential properties with resulting loss of outlook and privacy to the future occupiers of these properties. The proposal is contrary to policies ENV.1.1 (New Development), H.1.2 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.3.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development) of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan and associated Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Conversion of existing office building into 1 X two bedroomed dwellinghouse with associated parking, and single storey front extension
